definitions.explanation: A polite way of addressing or referring to a group of people. More formal than みなさん, commonly used in announcements, speeches, and formal writing.

examples.japanese: {皆様|みなさま}、おはようございます。
{皆様|みなさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I am grateful for everyone's cooperation.

examples.japanese: {皆様|みなさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ご{多幸|たこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I wish everyone good health and happiness.

notes:
{皆様|みなさま} is the honorific form of みなさん, using ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧ instead of さん.

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧: everyone (casual)
- みなさん: everyone (standard polite)
- {皆様|みなさま}: everyone (formal/honorific)

WHERE USED:
Standard in business emails, public announcements, formal speeches, and customer-facing communication. Using みなさん in these contexts would sound too casual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皆様|みなさま}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: to everyone (letter/email opening)
- {皆様|みなさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: thanks to everyone
- ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧{皆様|みなさま}: all of our customers
- ご⟦{来場|らいじょう}→来場：17703_raijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皆様|みなさま}: all attendees
- {皆様|みなさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧: I wish everyone good health (closing formula)
